title: Works, but cheap feeling plastic
text: Works, but cheap feeling plastic. Pretty cheap quality. Saw nicer ones at target for cheaper. They do the job, but expected more for the cost

product_metadata.title: HOMZ Set of 3 Holiday Wreath Plastic Storage Containers, Holds Up to 24” Diameter, Secure Latching Lid and Easy Grip Handle, Stackable and Nestable, Red/Clear
features: SAFELY STORE WREATHS: Make sure your faux wreath stays looking full and vibrant until it's time to display with this plastic wreath box
DURABLE PLASTIC: Made from durable plastic that withstands ongoing use year after year
EASY STORAGE: The wreath container can hang or stand on its own for easy storing options
CONVENIENT LID: Clear lid makes it easy to see what is inside at a glance
SET OF 3: This package contains 3 wreath storage containers
description: This set of 3 storage boxes protect delicate, decorative wreathes from one year to the next. Red base with clear plastic lid allows you to identify the design and season quickly. The tote will store any wreath up to 24 inches. Having recessed lids, these boxes hang, stack, or stand on their own. Four secure latches can be released so lid nests in the base for easy storage when not in use. A built-in handle makes it easy to carry.

details.Occasion: Christmas, Housewarming, Winter Holidays, Wedding & Engagement
